# FG-CI-0027

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`ci-runner`](../../ops/runbooks/ci-runner.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_changed_model_store_fails_the_job_before_any_container` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: CI の Runner のモデル置き場が、登録されたダイジェストと一致しませんでした。ジョブは実行されていません。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The CI runner's model store does not match its registered digests. The job did not run. Contact the administrator.
- id: Penyimpanan model runner CI tidak cocok dengan digest yang terdaftar. Tugas tidak dijalankan. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 17 P17-1 (ADR-0029 amendment 2026-11-14): the GPU runner hands its model store (`[gpu_eval.model_store]` `path`) read-only to a service that asked for the GPU, and first verifies it — at the runner's start and before every such job: `<path>/forge-models.sha256` (sha256sum lines `<hex>  <relative path>`) must have the configured `manifest_sha256` (`reason=manifest_digest`, with `expected` / `actual`; `manifest_missing`, `manifest_invalid` with `line` or `file`), every listed file must exist (`missing_file`) and have its sha256 (`file_digest`, with `file`, `expected`, `actual`), nothing else may be in the store (`unlisted_file`, `link` — a symbolic link —, `not_regular`, `name_invalid`, `too_deep`, `too_many_files`), nothing may be writable by group or others or owned by the runner's own user (`writable`, with `file`), and it must be readable (`unreadable`, `not_a_directory`). At the start a verification longer than one hour is `reason=deadline`. Someone changed or added a model file without updating the manifest and the runner's configuration, the store's ownership or modes are wrong, or the store was tampered with. The job fails before any pod or container: no service ever sees an unverified model; at the start the runner exits.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The runner host (`journalctl -u forge-runner`, JSON) logs it once (alert) with `error_code`, `request_id` and in `context` `reason`, `file`, `expected`, `actual` (and `job_id`, `attempt`, `pipeline_id`, `project_id` for a job); the job's log ends with the same code. Read-only on the host: `sha256sum <path>/forge-models.sha256` against `manifest_sha256` in `/etc/forge-runner/config.toml`; `cd <path> && sha256sum -c forge-models.sha256`; `find <path> -type l -o ! -type f ! -type d`; `find <path> -perm /022 -o -user <runner user>`; who changed the store (the host's audit log, `ls -l --time-style=full-iso`).

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook ci-runner (GPU runner): treat an unexplained change as a security event (incident). Otherwise restore the store from the approved models (models.toml digests), regenerate the manifest, put its sha256 in `manifest_sha256` and restart the runner — host changes need human approval. Never make the store writable by the runner's user.
